findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18 → 19)
findings.detail: package.json pins react and react-dom to ^18.3.1 (latest stable: 19.3.0). React 19 is the current major release and includes performance improvements and new features. Both packages must be upgraded together.
findings.suggested_fix: Update react and react-dom in package.json to ^19.3.0 and run npm install

findings.title: App.tsx recently changed but no App.test.tsx exists
findings.detail: src/web/App.tsx was modified within the last 14 days (commit on main). Sibling test files exist for most modules in src/web/ but App.tsx has no corresponding App.test.ts or App.test.tsx.
findings.suggested_fix: Add src/web/App.test.tsx covering the main rendering and layout of the App component
